answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9788 Country: India Title: assalam alikum,iam married fivr years back and still ihave no child, last two years i went for treatment for my wife,after intensive treatment includes one surgery doctors found cornal blockage and endromtreosis gr 4.Resulting this our dotor said we should go for test tube baby or ivf in which my sperm and and wife egg wiil be fertilized outsede and then injected in uterus.After this suggestion we went to several cities for any other kind of treatment but every where the ane answer is that only ivf can give us a child andthat also is ony 30 % chance only when allah wiil allow this this could happen.So finally i would like to know is ivf or testtube baby is allowed or not in islam and what are criterias, please let me know as soon as possible as i am very disturb nowdays.allah hafiz Question: assalam alikum,iam married fivr years back and still ihave no child, last two years i went for treatment for my wife,after intensive treatment includes one surgery doctors found cornal blockage and endromtreosis gr 4.Resulting this our dotor said we should go for test tube baby or ivf in which my sperm and and wife egg wiil be fertilized outsede and then injected in uterus.After this suggestion we went to several cities for any other kind of treatment but every where the ane answer is that only ivf can give us a child andthat also is ony 30 % chance only when allah wiil allow this this could happen.So finally i would like to know is ivf or testtube baby is allowed or not in islam and what are criterias, please let me know as soon as possible as i am very disturb nowdays.allah hafiz Answer ID: 9788 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 252/194=H/1429) Both the ways are haram . There is no wrong if you consult any other expert and religious hakim or doctor and adopt lawful alternative treatment. Adopt lawful and halal method and pay special attention to duas. If the children are better for you in this world and the hereafter then giving children is not impossible for Allah. But, if it is not better for you and not destined by Allah, then keep patience and stay thankful to Allah. Deliberate the matter of this world only that many people are so much troubled due to their children that your trouble is not even 4% compared to their troubles. They very earnestly wish that their children would have not been born. Even, we observe many wishing that their children may die before their eyes as soon as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
